releaseName: Top Header Version + Persistent Main Board and iPad
message: Verdant 15.4.11 moves the version card to the top beside PLAYERS and patches legacy Main Board and iPad distance-hiding source. Apply the installer and validate in Unity.
notes: Places version card beside the top PLAYERS card using parent-relative coordinates.
Disables source-based distance minimisation in VerdantBoard.cs.
Keeps the VerdantTablet.cs screen visible irrespective of player proximity.
Retains manually controlled UI options, supporter state and clock system.
Back up the Unity project before applying; Unity and UdonSharp testing is still required.
